title: Data Detective
mission: Turn synthetic sensor readings into a dashboard and investigate a suspicious interval.
steps: Load the CSV and show readings in a labeled table.
Add a machine selector and UTC date filters.
Draw temperature over time and calculate count, mean, min and max.
Investigate a suspicious interval and write three sentences supported by the selected readings.
checks: Changing a filter updates the table, chart and summary together.
Missing and malformed readings are reported rather than converted to zero.
An empty selection gives a useful message.
validation: Add explicit missing-value and duplicate handling, then explain your anomaly threshold.
extension: Compare machines or export filtered CSV safely.
hint: Begin with five rows in a table before building the chart. Decide which values count as valid.
